hypothesis: Explicit LOW thinking may reduce time to completion relative to MEDIUM on the same prompt-15 synthetic facts; quality must be assessed separately.
budgetLimitation: A $5 cap can stop this campaign before all four planned observations. Retain the full reservation for unknown usage; never bypass the next-attempt reservation guard to complete a pair.
stopPolicy: Halt on unavailability, unknown capture, source/model identity drift, invalid usage or insufficient next-attempt reservation. Retain every validator rejection as an observation. No retries or substitutions.
measurements: start, headers, body, abort and finish timestamps
reported model/response IDs, finish reason and full token usage
validator outcome, exact source-to-output semantics and final reflection
neutral paired review only when a case has both complete level observations

review.bodyThresholds: Preserve existing specificity/grounding/coherence and repetition thresholds; no substantive unsupported claims.
review.reflectionThresholds: Primary source question must permit rejection or none; assembled prompt must contain one safe question.

implementationPrerequisites: Create a separate versioned closed four-observation manifest; preserve the existing 24-call thinking experiment and both content-comparison versions.
Freeze per-position controls and exact baseline bytes/source identity in the durable campaign; prevent user overrides after freeze.
Enforce four total attempts, a separately authorized $5 cap, zero retries and full unknown-usage reservation.
Verify manifest, control propagation, source identities, safe-stop behavior and capture/report integrity offline; obtain an independent implementation review.
Publish and verify any required capability under its final source SHA; freeze that SHA and fresh rubric/manifest before generation.
Recheck authoritative source/account configuration and published rates; no credentials or private member data in captures.
interpretationLimits: One observation per case/level does not establish latency reliability or a causal explanation for the historical timeout.
Two baseline cases do not qualify the draft's changed copy, all tone/depth combinations, or wider release content.
Successful LOW output does not authorize a serving-policy change, replacement repair outputs, human approval or activation.
No extra paid reviewer API budget is included.
